content.short: Telos Consilium is a Web3 advisory and treasury firm offering risk-curated vault allocations on Plasma.
content.description: Telos Consilium works with Web3 projects as an advisory and treasury partner, covering risk-curated vault allocations, tokenized equity and capital structuring. On Plasma it acts as a risk curator, deciding which markets and collateral the vaults it manages are exposed to. Curators have become a distinct role in on-chain lending, sitting between depositors who want yield and the protocols that generate it, and taking responsibility for the risk parameters in between.
